name: Case Lifecycle and Rescue Workflow
coverage: ADMIN can cancel VALIDATION_PASSED, IN_PROGRESS, and PROCESSING_ANALYSIS cases.
ADMIN cannot cancel RESOLVED or CANCELLED cases.
VOLUNTEER, NGO, and USER cannot perform permanent cancellation from IN_PROGRESS.
Completion verification is only allowed from RESCUE_COMPLETED.
NGO completion verification requires jurisdiction; ADMIN verification does not.
notes: This is a functional workflow evaluation, not a real-world rescue-time or outcome-improvement measurement.
